headlines.title: Bosnia Court Blocks Republika Srpska From Funding Secessionist Lobbying
Bosnian Police Officer Dies by Suicide Following Raid
Bosnia Dismisses Two Soldiers for Glorifying Ratko Mladic
Bosnian Arms Probe Leads To Iran-Linked Criminal Network, Sources Tell RFE/RL

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Bosnia's court blocked Republika Srpska from funding secessionist lobbying. [1]
A Bosnian police officer died by suicide following a raid. [2]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR BOSNIA AND HERZEGOVINA
The court's block on secessionist lobbying may reduce tensions linked to the 26 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations affecting Bosnia & Herzegovina. [1][E2]

KEY RISKS
Bosnia & Herzegovina's net energy import dependency of 28% poses a risk of supply disruption amid political instability. [E3]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the arms probe leading to an Iran-linked criminal network remains unresolved. [4]
